before.failure: Blocked reply write stopped movement admission
before.production: Unchanged coordinator; only regression test added

checks: Admission continues during a blocked 16 KiB response over a 1 KiB duplex transport.
The partial frame resumes without duplicated bytes, and replies stay ordered.
The in-flight write counts toward the unchanged eight-request admission bound.
Known authentication loss stops admission while its denial reply is still blocked.
Durable fencing, storage-pause recovery, monitored draining, and delayed client pressure fixtures pass.

limits: The blocked-write regression isolates the transport coordinator with a channel representing authority; it does not simulate a full battle or prove zero movement expiries.
One Linux build job and a persistent target are used. An intermediate compiler run failed because the shared disk filled; no test verdict is inferred from it.
The high-resolution battle must still be measured with this change.
